evidence: Receiving DO2 online sensor: 10.81 mg/L at 45.8h dropping monotonically to 2.37 mg/L at 52.0h (rows idx 229-259)
Latest receiving product assay: P=2.776 g/L at t=239h (available 51.8h)
Forward model keep: post-decision min DO 1.454 mg/L, 2h below limit, post_decision_feasible=false
Forward model strong_feed_reduction: min DO 1.352 mg/L, 5.8h below limit; sensitivity max min DO 2.398 with only 1/5 feasible members (uncalibrated)
Forward model combined: min DO 1.180 mg/L, 7.6h below; reduce_feed: 1.028, 9.2h below; increase_air: 1.035, 9.2h below
Decision time 52.0h with estimated 44h remaining operating horizon
submission.rationale: Receiving DO2 is collapsing: ~10.8 mg/L at 45.8 h falling steeply to 2.37 mg/L at 52.0 h (trend ~-0.4 mg/L/h, no sign of recovery), with a ~44 h remaining horizon. The source-calibrated forward model centrally predicts every bounded operating plan violates the 2 mg/L DO hard constraint: keep (min 1.45, 2 h below), combined (1.18, 7.6 h), strong_feed_reduction (1.35, 5.8 h), reduce_feed (1.03, 9.2 h), increase_air (1.04, 9.2 h). Strong_feed_reduction has one favorable sensitivity member (2.40 mg/L), but the sensitivity set is uncalibrated and non-probabilistic, so per the decision rules it cannot justify a centrally infeasible plan. Since no operating plan can be supported as meeting the constraint, stop is the only defensible decision despite the product-mass sacrifice; a stop counts zero production, but violating the oxygen constraint cannot be compensated by product mass.
submission.uncertainty: The forward model is source-calibrated, not the hidden receiving realization; the observed DO crash corroborates it directionally, but the exact post-decision minimum DO is uncertain. If the true receiving oxygen-transfer capacity exceeds the model estimate, some intervention (strong_feed_reduction or combined) might remain feasible; however, the observed steep decline and the 44 h horizon make a feasible recovery unlikely, and the rule requires a centrally feasible plan to justify continued operation. A favorable model sensitivity member or a lagged recovery cannot overrule the central infeasible prediction.
